cohort: Newborn infants admitted to a Neonatology clinic between September 2020 and August 2021 due to indirect hyperbilirubinemia and undergoing exchange transfusion.
finding: ABO incompatibility (50%), Subgroup incompatibility (46.8%), Rh incompatibility (27.4%), and Glucose 6 phosphate dehydrogenase enzyme deficiency (21%) were identified as common etiologies for indirect hyperbilirubinemia requiring exchange transfusion.
